collection.title: Mercedes-Benz A Class Hatchback 2018 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Mercedes-Benz A Class 2018 onwards (W177) model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" for the passengers side. This model uses the Specific Fit Mercedes-Benz arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this A Class, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.

image.alt: Mercedes-Benz A Class Hatchback 2018 to 2022 Windscreen Wiper Blades
